# Interior mirror upgrades and electronics

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Route wiring through the headliner and connect power, then mount a Gentex mirror kit for interior upgrades. [t625]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Ensure the old mirror can be removed by inserting a 4mm hex key into its bottom slot and wiggling it off.
2. Pry off the covers of the driver's side door handle, then use a Phillips head screwdriver to remove the screws underneath.
3. [Partial] Pull the door trim panel away from the body without detaching it completely so it can be easily repositioned later.
4. [Partial] Unclip and pull down the A-pillar cover on the driver's side by pulling toward the windshield to avoid breaking clips.
5. Route wiring through the headliner, down the A-pillar, and into the driver's footwell where a thick red ignition wire is located.
6. Connect the positive power wire using vampire clips onto the left side of the footwell's thick red wire.
7. Ground the mirror's other wire to an existing ground point in the footwell near the sound spot area.
8. Mount the new mirror and tighten its T20 Torx bit securely but without overtightening.
9. Attach the curved wire cover over the mirror base and insert the square end into the headliner for a finished look.
10. Hold the power button for 9 seconds to display the current zone number on the screen, then press it repeatedly until the correct zone is selected.
11. [Partial] Drive in circles at an open area while holding the power button for 12 seconds or until 'C' appears to begin compass calibration.
12. [Partial] Rotate the mirror housing until a cardinal direction reading (N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW) stabilizes on the display.

_Procedure reported by [t625]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.xterranation.org/index.php?threads/how-to-gentex-mirror-install.1398/>_

## Tools

- 4mm hex key [t625]
- Phillips head screwdriver [t625]
- T20 Torx bit [t625]

## Parts

- [Partial] Decorative wire cover [t625]
- [Partial] Gentex Mirror Kit [t625]
- [Partial] Vampire clips, optional [t625]

## Tips & gotchas

- Do not pull the door trim all the way off initially to make lining it back up easier. [t625]
- [Partial] Pull A-pillar clips toward the windshield rather than the door side to prevent breakage. [t625]
